Yahoo API overlay: team totals keep the points already scored (the API's projected total is pregame)

Dom caught DK I's opponent total. The API's team projected points ignore actual points, so Punching Bag
read 166.5 instead of 175.9 after Thursday night. Now the total is the Chrome total with every
window that has kicked off replaced by the API's actual points; tested against the 7:53 AM read:
48 of 48 teams, win % within 1, totals within 0.6 on average.

Yahoo API overlay: brief and meters use the API's newer win %, totals, lineups and points between Chrome reads; 4:30 AM build

The 5 AM brief sat on Thursday's 5:02 PM Chrome read and missed Thursday night's game, though the
API read had it every build. Now every build lays the API numbers over the last Chrome read
(league_windows_api.txt, dom_matchups_api.txt). Yahoo per-player projections stay Chrome-only
(the API refuses them). Tested on the Oct 30 5:02 AM inputs: DK I Yahoo win % 22 (API) vs 29 (stale Chrome).
